findings.text: follow-on: the exclusion is name-based and root-anchored, so an untracked top-level harness/ or codex-home/ directory that a run genuinely delivered without committing is dropped from the tree state and crew gc --apply would reclaim it as scratch; the constant assumes a reserved name that nothing enforces where the directory is created.

follow-on: _inspect_workspace now derives its dirty list from _tree_state, which reads git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all, so an untracked directory is reported per file (?? notes/x) rather than as one collapsed entry (?? notes/); the reported dirty shape changes for every untracked directory, broader than the harness-scratch goal, and the manifest does not disclose it.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 27c67a3a; one source file, one test file and one evidence fragment, 235 insertions and 5 deletions, every changed path inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names a base reproduction, a named-constant exclusion, three tests/test_crew_gc.py cases, a declared negative control and base and head gate arms; the manifest records each and the logs on disk bear out base 3 failed / 28 passed versus head 31 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to stop crew gc reading a worker's harness scratch as uncommitted work so an integrated worktree classifies integrated; reckon/crew/routing.py:514 leaves exactly the top-level untracked codex-home/ and harness/ out of _tree_state, and the reproduction at logs/base_repro.log and logs/head_repro.log shows classification dirty to integrated and reclaimable 0 to 1.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; status is complete, two commits are named, both gate logs are named, baseline_suite and after_suite carry completed true with literal commands, and the negative-control path and declared string are recorded.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's four declared paths; the two commits touch reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_crew_gc.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the grant, and nothing outside it.

justifications.durability: the three cases added at tests/test_crew_gc.py:253, :275 and :298 each redden when the exclusion is removed — the base arm shows all three failing and the negative control shows the scratch-only case reddening alone — and none compares a value against the same input the test itself passed in.
justifications.evidence: logs/base_gate.log and logs/head_gate.log name their revision on line 1 and end EXIT=1 and EXIT=0 with 3 failed / 31 passed, and logs/negative_control.log repeats the declared mutation verbatim; docked one because the manifest quotes ruff as 11 findings base and 11 head while the changed source and test files measure 9 each, the 11 counting the run-directory driver, so the delta still holds but the figure is not over the changed paths alone.
justifications.fit: one named constant and one predicate at reckon/crew/routing.py:514 and :517 follow the surrounding style and describe their mechanism, and the commit subjects and bodies carry no plan labels or attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:514 excludes the harness scratch from _tree_state, and the base and head reproduction shows classification dirty to integrated and reclaimable 0 to 1, so the stated goal is met at the changed revision.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only the three written declared paths (reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_crew_gc.py, the evidence fragment) and nothing outside them, though routing.py:622 _inspect_workspace's refactor to read _tree_state is broader than the goal strictly requires.
